name: One Small Tweak
reference: 37s, three camera setups so it never sits still: tight face, full wide, side close. Box hook for the first 3 seconds, then one big outlined word at a time.
edit_notes:
Pro tip: 'Change this [setting] for more [result]:' then confirm the viewer's fear, 'I did the work for you', a contrarian reframe, an open loop, and the payoff with the comment keyword. Hook: one box, one sentence ending in a colon (one hook line; it wraps). Gone after 3 seconds.

Captions are one word at a time: keep it brisk.

Camera: tight on the face for the hook, full frame for the fear, a closer side angle for 'I did the work', full frame for the reframe, tight again for the call to action.
